entities.summary: Dinelson Lamet Hernandez is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher for El Águila de Veracruz of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Diego Padres, Colorado Rockies, Boston Red Sox, and Los Angeles Dodgers, and in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the TSG Hawks.
